import pandas as pd
from typing import Dict

def run(inputs: Dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> Dict[str, pd.DataFrame]:
    target_snapshot = inputs["target_snapshot"].copy()
    cdc_events = inputs["cdc_events"].copy()
    watermark = inputs["watermark"].copy()
    
    # Extract the watermark high_ts value
    high_ts = watermark["high_ts"].iloc[0]
    
    # Step 1: Filter events to only those after the watermark
    new_events = cdc_events[cdc_events["event_ts"] > high_ts].copy()
    
    # Step 2: For each product_id, get the latest event by (event_ts, event_seq)
    # Sort by event_ts ascending, then event_seq ascending, and take the last row per product_id
    if len(new_events) > 0:
        new_events = new_events.sort_values(by=["product_id", "event_ts", "event_seq"])
        latest_events = new_events.drop_duplicates(subset=["product_id"], keep="last")
    else:
        latest_events = new_events
    
    # Step 3: Process the latest events
    # Separate deletes from inserts/updates
    if len(latest_events) > 0:
        delete_events = latest_events[latest_events["op"] == "D"]
        upsert_events = latest_events[latest_events["op"].isin(["I", "U"])]
    else:
        delete_events = pd.DataFrame()
        upsert_events = pd.DataFrame()
    
    # Get product_ids to delete
    delete_product_ids = set(delete_events["product_id"].values) if len(delete_events) > 0 else set()
    
    # Remove deleted products from snapshot
    new_snapshot = target_snapshot[~target_snapshot["product_id"].isin(delete_product_ids)].copy()
    
    # Process upserts
    if len(upsert_events) > 0:
        # For each product in upsert_events, update or insert
        for _, event in upsert_events.iterrows():
            product_id = event["product_id"]
            name = event["name"]
            price = event["price"]
            event_ts = event["event_ts"]
            
            # Check if product exists in snapshot
            mask = new_snapshot["product_id"] == product_id
            if mask.any():
                # Update existing product
                new_snapshot.loc[mask, "name"] = name
                new_snapshot.loc[mask, "price"] = price
                new_snapshot.loc[mask, "last_event_ts"] = event_ts
            else:
                # Insert new product
                new_row = pd.DataFrame({
                    "product_id": [product_id],
                    "name": [name],
                    "price": [price],
                    "last_event_ts": [event_ts]
                })
                new_snapshot = pd.concat([new_snapshot, new_row], ignore_index=True)
    
    # Ensure column order and types match target_snapshot schema
    new_snapshot = new_snapshot[["product_id", "name", "price", "last_event_ts"]]
    new_snapshot["product_id"] = new_snapshot["product_id"].astype("int64")
    new_snapshot["name"] = new_snapshot["name"].astype("object")
    new_snapshot["price"] = new_snapshot["price"].astype("float64")
    new_snapshot["last_event_ts"] = pd.to_datetime(new_snapshot["last_event_ts"], utc=False)
    
    # Sort by product_id for deterministic output
    new_snapshot = new_snapshot.sort_values(by="product_id", ignore_index=True)
    
    return {"new_snapshot": new_snapshot}
